node.title: Rank-eleven relative correction-space incidence router
node.closure: uniform shortened-row proper-intersection and clone-tolerant compilers with exact positive-dimensional residual
node.statement: For an H_C correction span W of dimension s, proper bidegree-(31,1) incidence gives N_W<=31(s+1) binom(n',s+1)/binom(m',s+1), uniformly paying s<=11; the first adjacent formula at s=12 exceeds budget. If W does not absorb the high core, generalized-weight basis curves give N_W<=M_a n'_fall_s/(d+a)_rise_s, uniformly paying s<=9. Hence every over-budget H_C residual has dimension at least 12 or a positive-dimensional evaluation rank-flat/polynomial clone component; every survivor of dimension at most 9 absorbs the high core.
